newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia state firms to post 10.5 trln rph profit.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia state firms to post 10.5 trln rph profit.

text.p: Indonesian Finance Minister Mar'ie Muhammad said on Wednesday the country's state-owned firms were expected to post a 10.5 trillion rupiah pre-tax profit in 1996 against 9.32 trillion rupiah result in 1995.
Mar'ie Muhammad said the financial performance of state-owned firms was expected to rise after recent government efforts to restructure and provide more autonomy to the firms.
"The firms are expected to post a pre-tax profit of 10.5 trillion rupiah in 1996 against 9.32 trillion rupiah in 1995 and 7.73 trillion rupiah in 1994," Mar'ie told a parliamentary committee.
Mar'ie said the restructuring programmes and other efforts had produced the encouraging results.
He said the state-owned firms posted a pre-tax profit of 5.55 trillion rupiah in the first six months of 1996.
"The number of state-owned firms with very sound financial results and sound results have increased while those with poor and very poor results have decreased in number," Mar'ie said.

He said 85 out of a total of 182 state-owned firms had very sound and sound results in 1994. In 1995 there were 92 firms with sound and very sound results out of 178 firms after the restructuring programme.
Mar'ie did not any give further details.
